title: Ornate Fantasy Dagger
description: A single ornate dagger is displayed diagonally against a dark background. The curved blade is off-white with green vine-like patterns, a glowing red central line, and a jagged edge, while the hilt features intricate metalwork, jewels, wrapped grip, and a leafy pommel.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy dagger floating diagonally on a dark blue textured background, the curved blade is pale with glowing green vine patterns and a bright red central vein, ornate crossguard embedded with blue and purple jewels, white wrapped handle, pommel shaped like a pinecone with green leaves sprouting from the hilt, dramatic lighting with soft shadows, realistic oil painting style
